latest.profileDigest: Independent developer. Projects: orbit-notes (TypeScript, React, sync engine), tidepool (Python, DuckDB), paper-lantern (Node, Markdown), fieldkit (Node CLI), agent-playbook. Agents: Claude, Codex, Copilot, DeepSeek web, OpenCode. Wants local-first tools with small setup.
